name: UISEE Technologies (Beijing) Co., Ltd. Class H
summary: UISEE Technologies (Beijing) Co., Ltd. is a Beijing-based provider of AI-driven autonomous driving technology, founded in 2016. It designs self-driving industrial tractors, shuttle buses, heavy trucks and passenger vehicles, outsourcing manufacturing, and sells driving hardware kits, software and vehicle leasing. China is its main market, with operations also in Hong Kong, the UAE, Singapore and Qatar, serving logistics, chemicals, airport, factory and vehicle maker customers.
